privatecall.title: PrivateCall
privatecall.subtitle: Voice and video directly between two browsers—no accounts or call servers.
privatecall.roleHint: Who starts the call shares an invite. The other person joins with that invite and sends a response back.
privatecall.wrongRoleOffer: That is a call invite — you already started the call.
privatecall.wrongRoleAnswer: That is a response — join with the caller's invite first.
privatecall.howItWorks: Calls use WebRTC with several public STUN servers to discover paths through NAT. Exchange invite/response (copy or QR); media flows directly—nothing is uploaded to our servers.
privatecall.iceHint: If the call does not connect, wait a few seconds and copy fresh invite/response so more STUN candidates are included.
privatecall.errorConnection: Could not connect. Check the pairing codes and try again.
privatecall.remoteHangUp: The other person ended the call.

privatechat.title: PrivateChat
privatechat.subtitle: Text and files directly between two browsers—one private link, no chat server.
privatechat.roleHint: Who creates the room shares an invite. The other person joins and sends a response back.
privatechat.wrongRoleOffer: That is a room invite — you already created the room.
privatechat.wrongRoleAnswer: That is a response — join with the host invite first.
privatechat.howItWorks: Chat and file chunks share one WebRTC data channel. Exchange invite/response (copy or QR); messages never pass through our servers (DTLS between peers only).
privatechat.iceHint: If chat does not connect, wait a few seconds and copy fresh invite/response.
privatechat.errorConnection: Could not connect. Check the pairing codes and try again.
privatechat.peerLeft: The other person left the chat.
privatechat.encryptionHint: Messages and files travel over a WebRTC data channel encrypted with DTLS between the two browsers. Nothing is saved to IndexedDB or disk in PrivateChat—only kept in memory until you leave the room. The invite/response you copy for pairing is plain text—share it only with your contact.

whiteboard.title: PrivateWhiteboard
whiteboard.subtitle: Shared drawing canvas between two browsers—manual pairing, no cloud canvas server.
whiteboard.roleHint: Who creates the room shares the invite. The other person joins and sends back a response.
whiteboard.wrongRoleOffer: That is a room invite—you already created the room.
whiteboard.wrongRoleAnswer: That is a response—join first with the invite from whoever created the room.
whiteboard.howItWorks: Strokes sync over a WebRTC data channel (DTLS). Exchange invite and response (copy or QR); drawing data never hits our servers.
whiteboard.iceHint: If the board does not connect, wait a few seconds and copy invite/response again.
whiteboard.errorConnection: Could not connect. Check the codes and try again.
whiteboard.peerLeft: The other person left the board.
whiteboard.encryptionHint: Drawing commands travel over a WebRTC data channel encrypted with DTLS between the two browsers. Nothing is stored on our servers—only in memory until you leave. Pairing invite/response is plain text.

privatedrop.title: PrivateDrop
privatedrop.subtitle: Direct transfer between two browsers—small files or multi‑gigabyte, chunked with no server upload.
privatedrop.roleHint: The sender creates the room and shares an invite. The receiver joins with that invite and sends a response back.
privatedrop.qrTooLarge: This invite is too large for a QR code. Use “Copy invite” / “Copy response” instead.
privatedrop.scanCameraHint: Point at the other device's QR code
privatedrop.wrongRoleOffer: That is an invite — you already created the room as sender.
privatedrop.wrongRoleAnswer: That is a response — paste the sender's invite first, or send your response to them.
privatedrop.cameraPermission: Camera access was denied or unavailable.
privatedrop.scanNotSupported: QR scanning is not supported in this browser.
privatedrop.stepHost1: Share the QR or copied data with the receiver.
privatedrop.stepHost2: Paste the answer from the receiver.
privatedrop.stepGuest1: Paste or scan the sender's data.
privatedrop.stepGuest2: Copy your answer back to the sender.
privatedrop.dropFiles: Drop files here or click to browse
privatedrop.waitingForFiles: Waiting for files from the sender…
privatedrop.errorConnection: Connection failed. Check signaling data and try again.
privatedrop.iceHint: If connection stalls, copy updated signaling data after a few seconds.
privatedrop.natWarning: Some networks block direct connections. A future version may add optional TURN relay (signaling only, never your files).
privatedrop.howItWorks: No file server: you exchange a short invite/response (copy or QR) to open a direct link. Files stream in chunks over WebRTC—any size—and never pass through our site (only SDP/ICE in the pairing text).
privatedrop.statusSignaling: Waiting for pairing (exchange invite + response on both sides)
privatedrop.notConnectedSend: Not connected yet. Complete pairing on both devices until status shows Connected.

adblock.title: Turn off ad blocking for this site
adblock.body: Brave Shields, AdGuard, or another blocker is interfering with Private Tools. WebRTC pairing and scripts can fail while filters stay on.
adblock.tipBrave: Brave: tap the Shields icon in the address bar → turn Shields down for this site or add an exception.
adblock.tipAdguard: AdGuard: open the extension → disable protection on this site or add it to the allowlist.
adblock.tipGeneric: uBlock Origin and similar: open the extension and disable blocking on this domain, then recheck.
adblock.why: We do not show ads. Blockers still hide probe elements and block scripts the app needs to run reliably.
adblock.signalCosmetic: Cosmetic ad filter detected (bait element was hidden).
